plan.title: Secret requests: clicking the Needs-you item opens the conversation, which has no secret input
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One operator-facing bug: the secret input must be reachable from every Needs-you surface and from the owner's conversation. The ~30 files are the request store/route (issue id), the shared card, one dialog host, one selector branch, the pinned card with its three owner mounts (conversation panel, agent drawer, Stage session pane, so terminal views are covered) and three surface hooks, plus their tests and docs; shipping any slice alone leaves some Needs-you entry point still landing on a page with no input.

narratives.Problem: When an agent calls request_secret (or link_machine), the Needs-you item opens navigateToDecisionSubject with the request id as the subject id: a conversation owner goes to /conv/<request id>, which does not exist, and an agent owner goes nowhere. Project Home drops the item entirely because decision items carry no projectKey. The only answer UI, AgentRequestCard, mounts only in DecisionsPanel inside the Activity panel's Needs you tab, and the owning conversation shows nothing.
narratives.Proposal: Add issueId to agent request rows (server). Extract the card's answer body into AgentRequestAnswer with machine-naming elsewhere text. Add a global agent-request dialog (store + host in main.tsx) that the Needs-you selector opens for agent-request items, which also get a project key. Pin AgentRequestCard at the top of the owner's ConversationPanel (embedded or not). Flag the owner in the conversation list and Live dock locally, render the answer body on the phone list, document it, and verify live with a real request_secret.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Answering a secret or machine link from a phone, paired device or another machine's browser (server root-only rule D-4 stays).
- Linked-machine (fleet) Needs-you rows or push notifications for agent requests.
- Server-side pending-input kinds for agent requests (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-list.ts, src/lib/agent-enrichment.ts) or any change to usePendingInputSubjects.
- Changing Decision.id for agent requests (it stays the request id).
- Changing the conversation row awaiting-input indicator click (it keeps calling requestReopen).
- Changing DecisionsPanel grouping or its inline AgentRequestCard placement.
- New polling: no new query key or interval for agent requests.
- Putting a secret value in any URL, log, toast, store or analytics event.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you items for agent requests open a global dialog (no navigation).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance requires the masked input "without any other navigation"; a dialog also works for agent owners with no route, and the anywhereDialogStore/AnywhereDialogHost pattern already exists.

autoDecisions.summary: Also pin the card at the top of the owner's ConversationPanel, embedded or not.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue fix item 2 requires the conversation view to show the input; the work-agent drawer mounts ConversationPanel embedded, so gating on !embedded would hide it for agent owners.

autoDecisions.summary: Server adds issueId to agent request rows.
autoDecisions.rationale: Agent-owned requests otherwise have no structured issue id, so the Needs-you item cannot be filed under a project and project Home drops it; the caller's issueId is known exactly at creation.

autoDecisions.summary: Conversation list and Live dock flag owners with a local overlay, not server pending-input kinds.
autoDecisions.rationale: Server kinds would feed usePendingInputSubjects, push notifications and the selector's section (a), double-counting the item and wiring a reopen click with no dialog payload.

autoDecisions.summary: Non-root text names the machine and gives the reason, with a fallback when the label is unknown.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue fix item 3; the old "this machine" fallback reads wrong for a remote viewer.

autoDecisions.summary: Live verification uses the work agent's own request_secret and Vite on port 3010 proxied to the live dashboard, with a recorded fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: Port 3010 is the only dev origin the server trusts and a loopback peer mints a root session; the self-verify rule requires a real screenshot.
